Riba-X

A full-stack social-commerce platform that combines feeds, profiles, messaging, and creator posts with a marketplace, cart, Stripe checkout, and seller tools.

Overview

Building a focused product around a real workflow.

Riba-X explores what happens when a social network and a marketplace share the same product experience. People can build profiles, publish content, connect through messaging, and move naturally from discovery to purchase.

Key capabilities
01

Social feeds, profiles, creator posts and direct messaging

02

Marketplace listings, cart experiences and seller tools

03

Stripe-powered checkout flow

04

Full-stack architecture backed by PostgreSQL
